heading: EXT. DRY PLAINS - HIGH NOON - SERIES OF SHOTS

units.text: EXT. DRY PLAINS - HIGH NOON - SERIES OF SHOTS
SERIES OF SHOTS:
A) Dust.
A long line of people in wide hats and hand-painted signs marching down a dirt road.
A banner: THE RIVER IS NOT FOR SALE.
B) Dana, 30s, in a duster coat, leads the march with a megaphone.
The sun slams down on her like a hammer.
C) Eli, 20s, thin, carries a drum.
Every step, BOOM.
D) Rosa, 50s, wipes her brow with a faded flag.
She's done this before.
E) Hank, 60s, in a sheriff's badge, arms crossed beside a rusted oil derrick.
His horse noses a tumbleweed.
F) Two teenagers on a fence post film everything on their phones.
A coyote watches from the ridge.
G) Tess, 20s, kneels on the road and locks her arm into a barrel of concrete.
CLINK.
H) Cole, 40s, in a company suit and cowboy boots, steps out of a black truck.
The door SLAMS.
END SERIES OF SHOTS.
